pure-announcement.rationale: A book chapter, not an announcement.

duplicate.rationale: No SLO or alerting concept exists in this corpus.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Published methodology with worked examples; every claim is reproducible.

durability.rationale: The precision/recall/detection/reset evaluation frame and burn-rate alerting are the industry-standard treatment; the chapter explicitly abstracts beyond its Prometheus syntax.

actionability.rationale: Gives directly implementable alerting rules and the trade-off analysis needed to choose between them.

atomicity.rationale: One coherent topic — turning SLOs into alerts — developed through successive refinements.
